Lake Erie Native American Council

The Lake Erie Native American Council is a Cleveland community organization. Cleveland Public Theatre recognized its community work in 2021 and credited it as a partner for its March 2026 production of Haunted.

Selected reading

Community work and arts partnerships

Cleveland Public Theatre identified the Council as a Cleveland organization in its 2021 Station Hope program. Its production record for Haunted, a play by Tara Moses, credits the Council as a partner for the March 2026 run.
